description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {2}{R} reduced by {1} for each experience counter you have, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
If you have fewer than three experience counters, Mizzix of the Izmagnus triggers, giving you an experience counter.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.
